description: Economic releases with forecasts, prior values and the actual once it prints, plus Fed speakers and auction times. Defaults to yesterday through the next 7 days; widen days_back and days_ahead to see more, or filter to one country like US, EU, GB or JP. Pass event to read one release's consensus record instead: for each past print the consensus that stood, the first actual, the previous and the revised prior, with its surprise, newest first. Across the US, the euro area, the UK, Japan and Germany; how far back a call reads is the plan's history window (12 months on Starter, 24 on Pro, 10 years on Ultimate).

country.description: Two-letter country or bloc, like US, EU, GB, JP. Empty means everywhere.

days_ahead.description: How many days ahead to include. Default 7, up to 365.

days_back.description: How many days of already-printed events to include. Default 1, up to 90.

event.description: One release whose consensus record to read: a series slug like cpi, or a release name as the calendar prints it, like Consumer Price Index (MoM) or GB: Retail Sales (MoM).

fresh.description: Set true to ask for the live view of this one call, for 5 credits, where the connected account otherwise receives it an hour behind. Accepted and free where the account is already live. No effect without a key.

limit.description: Most events to return. Default 100. With event, most rows, up to 520.

since.description: With event: the oldest release date to include, like 2018-01-01. How far back you can go depends on your plan.

name: get_economic_calendar
title: Economic calendar
